policy.sourceScope: Public webpages and user-provided reference URLs only.
policy.blockedScope: Do not crawl app.spline.design or private/login/paid scenes; robots for app.spline.design disallows crawling.
policy.usage: Store reusable motion vocabulary, interaction patterns, and implementation prompts. Do not copy private scene files or protected assets.

applicationPrompts: Use 3d-scene, cinematic-scroll, cursor-responsive, hover-magnetic, motion-field, orbit, parallax, reveal-mask, timeline-animation as motion vocabulary; recreate the feeling with HTML/CSS/Three.js/Spline-inspired code, not by copying protected assets.
Prefer full-viewport scenes, scroll-linked depth, cursor-responsive lighting, reveal masks, and one coherent camera/motion path when they fit the brief.
Audit the artifact against the reference at feel level: section rhythm, depth, motion timing, interaction model, and 16:9/21:9 composition.
